title: What are the best AvaTrade strategy resources for consistent trading?
author: ibrahimdigital
selftext:
I've been trading AvaTrade for a while, but I'm still trying to find a strategy that's consistent over the long term.

There are so many methods out there- price action, trend following, scalping, breakout strategies, and ICT/SMC concepts- that it's hard to know what actually works.

What strategy has given you the best results? Also, are there any websites or learning resources you'd genuinely recommend for improving forex trading skills?

Looking forward to hearing real experiences from other traders.

comments.author: ibrahim_40
comments.body: I've been using AvaTrade as one of my learning resources. I like that it explains the reasoning behind setups instead of just giving buy/sell signals
